name: Networking
description: Understanding network protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSH, firewalls, load balancing, reverse proxies, SSL/TLS, and cloud networking concepts.

subskills.name: TCP/IP & OSI Model
subskills.description: Understanding network layers, TCP vs UDP, IP addressing, subnetting, and CIDR notation.

subskills.name: DNS (Domain Name System)
subskills.description: DNS record types, resolution process, TTL, nameservers, and troubleshooting.

subskills.name: HTTP/HTTPS Protocols
subskills.description: HTTP methods, status codes, headers, REST APIs, and HTTPS/TLS handshake.

subskills.name: SSH Protocol
subskills.description: Secure shell access, key-based authentication, port forwarding, and tunneling.

subskills.name: Firewalls & Security Groups
subskills.description: Ingress/egress rules, iptables, nftables, ufw, and cloud security groups.

subskills.name: Load Balancing
subskills.description: Layer 4 vs Layer 7 load balancing, algorithms, health checks, and high availability.

subskills.name: Reverse Proxy
subskills.description: Nginx/HAProxy as reverse proxy, SSL termination, caching, and traffic routing.

subskills.name: SSL/TLS & Certificates
subskills.description: TLS handshake, certificate management, Let's Encrypt, and mutual TLS.

subskills.name: Network Troubleshooting
subskills.description: Using diagnostic tools to identify and resolve connectivity issues.

subskills.name: Cloud & Container Networking
subskills.description: VPC design, subnets, NAT gateways, route tables, CNI, and service discovery.

github.signal: Nginx or HAProxy configuration files present
SSL/TLS certificate configuration or Let's Encrypt setup
Firewall rules or security group definitions in IaC
VPC or network infrastructure in Terraform/CloudFormation
DNS configuration in IaC (Route53, CloudDNS, etc.)

cv.signal: Specific tools mentioned (Nginx, HAProxy, load balancer)

assessment.signal: Can explain DNS resolution process and record types
Can configure a reverse proxy with SSL termination
Can troubleshoot network connectivity issues using CLI tools

junior.description: Understands TCP/IP basics, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSH, and can troubleshoot basic connectivity issues.

mid.description: Can configure firewalls, set up load balancers and reverse proxies, and manage SSL/TLS certificates.

senior.description: Can design complex cloud network architectures, implement service meshes, and optimize network performance at scale.
